illustrations.caption: 4コマ。①教室で給食の残飯バケツを覗き込む教師（One day in April）②厨房で調理員とクリップボードのグラフを見ながら相談。「Reduce Food Waste」のポスター（The next week）③生徒は少なめの量を食べ、バケツはほぼ空。教師は満足げ（Two months later）④運動部の生徒2人が空のトレーを持って空腹そう。壁に「No Second Helpings」。教師は心配そう（In July）。

narration.storyLine: This is a story about a teacher who tried to reduce the food left over at school lunch.
narration.openingSentence: One day in April, a teacher was looking into a large bucket of leftover school lunch.

questions.prompt: Please look at the fourth picture. If you were the person in the picture, what would you be thinking?
questions.modelAnswer: I'd be thinking that cutting the portions solved one problem and created another. Students who play sports need far more food than the others, so one rule for everyone was too simple. I should ask the cook to prepare different sizes rather than reduce the amount for the whole class.

questions.prompt: Do you think schools should teach children more about food?
Some people say that food waste is one of the most serious problems facing the world today. Do you agree?
Do you think Japan should produce more of its own food?
